## DCIT208 Pull Request Checklist

### 1. Requirement or issue addressed

Link the GitHub Issue/User Story this PR addresses:

Closes #

### 2. What changed?

Explain the change in your own words.

### 3. Evidence of testing

List the tests you added or ran.

- [ ] Unit test added/updated
- [ ] Integration test added/updated
- [ ] Manual test performed
- [ ] Screenshot/video evidence included where relevant

### 4. Requirements traceability

Which requirement, use case, or user story does this change support?

### 5. AI usage disclosure

Did you use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, Cursor, Google AI Studio, Stitch, or another AI tool?

- [ ] No AI tool was used.
- [ ] Yes, AI was used and logged in `AI_USAGE_LOG.md`.

If yes, summarize what AI helped with and what you personally verified.

### 6. Reviewer responsibility

Reviewer must confirm:

- [ ] I understand what this PR is trying to achieve.
- [ ] I reviewed the code/documentation carefully.
- [ ] I checked whether the change matches the linked requirement.
- [ ] I checked for obvious security, privacy, or data-handling issues.
- [ ] I checked that tests or evidence are adequate.
